Commentary.Commentary: 173 to win then. Should be a cakewalk for India. Can Pakistan make a fist of it? Stay tuned for the run chase.

Perfect bowling by India. They stuck to their lines and lengths, with Kartik Tyagi swinging the ball like a banana. Sushant Mishra took care of the short stuff and ended up with 3 wickets. The spinners did not take too many wickets today but combined figures of 17-0-75-3 are more than acceptable between Ravi Bishnoi and Atharva Ankolekar. Yashasvi Jaiswal bowled his part-time leggies and returned with a scalp of the set Haider as well.

Just 3 batsmen managed double figures - Haider Ali, Rohail Nazir and Mohammad Haris - the rest just withered away. In fact, the last 6 wickets fell for just 26 runs. A monumental collapse. They had no answer to the spin or the swing movement from the Indian bowlers or even to the short stuff from them.

In a high-pressure game, Pakistan wilt again. They did all the preparations, practiced long and hard yesterday, even turned up 2 hours before the scheduled reporting time today - but calm and cool India have just blown them away for a paltry 172. The Boys In Green did start off confidently, were looking in good shape too for some time but then lost their way in the middle overs.

Sushant Mishra is down for a chat. Says that the pitch was having some bounce. Hence, he was backing his strengths and bowling accordingly. On Divyaansh Saxena's superb catch to dismiss Mohammad Haris, Sushant smiles and says that their coach always tells them that you should always try for catches. Normally, they stick.

OUT! CAUGHT! The final wicket goes down and PAKISTAN HAVE BEEN DISMISSED FOR 172. Length ball just outside off, Ali looks to go over the man at mid off but gets a top edge on it. Siddhesh Veer runs to his left from extra cover and takes an easy catch to end the innings.
Mohammad Amir Khan is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dhruv Jurel takes the catch and India are one wicket away from wrapping up the innings. They have been superb throughout the innings and the pressure has paid off. A bouncer on off, Hussain looks to rock back and pull. The ball goes off the top edge towards first slip but Jurel gives the shout that it is his catch and pouches it comfortably. India need 1 wicket to wrap up the innings.
Full ball on off, pushed towards cover.
Full length ball on middle and off, Ali looks to play at this one but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Ali does well to sway away from it.
Wide! Down the leg side, Aamir Ali looks to flick this one but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Length ball on off, Ali looks to have a poke at it but fails.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Kartik Tyagi is back on. 7-0-29-1, his figures so far.
Length ball above the middle pole line, Ali is in two minds but in the end lets it go.
Good length ball on middle and off, Ali defends this one towards mid on.
Aamir Ali is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rohail Nazir, the Pakistan skipper and lone warrior walks back. Mishra bowls a back of a length ball on middle, Nazir looks to rock back and pull but gets a top edge on this one. The ball lobs towards square leg where Tilak Varma takes an easy catch. The resistance from the skipper is finally broken and India looking to wrap things up as soon as possible.
Length ball on middle and leg, Nazir looks to rock back and pull but the ball hits Nazir very high on the pads. The bowler appeals but nothing given.
Back of a length ball just outside off, Hussain hops and guides this one awkwardly down to third man for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, Nazir punches this one off the back foot towards cover point for one.
Sushant Mishra is back on. 7-0-26-1 so far.
Another one on the pads, worked towards the leg side but this time no runs.
On the pads, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery outside off, Nazir looks to defend but the ball spins away and is beaten.
Nazir this time prods forward and defends it out.
Rohail finally looking to go big now! He dances down the track and tries to heave it towards mid-wicket but gets an inside edge on it and the ball stays near his boot.
Floated on off, pushed towards cover.
Powerplay 3 is underway! 5 fielders allowed outside the circle now. Will Priyam Garg want that facility though?
Third full toss of the over, this time it is outside off, Nazir looks to push this one towards the off side but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Another full toss by Tyagi, this time on middle and off, Nazir just defends this one towards the off side.
Yorker outside off, Rohail just about manages to jam it out towards the off side.
Looks a bit rattled there, does Nazir, after that beamer. Outside off, on a length, Rohail pushes inside the line and is beaten.
Excellent delivery on the Free Hit. Yorker outside off, dug out back to the bowler.
FREE HIT TIME!
THAT IS A BATSMAN KILLER! A high full toss, right at the face, Rohail ducks and just about gets out of harm's way. The umpire warns Tyagi. Another beamer at the face and Kartik will be off.

Huge, huge shout for LBW! Not given. Almost nails the perfect yorker, hitting the batsman on the boot but perhaps going own the leg side, as per the replays. Too much doubt. Nazir looked to defend but missed it completely.
Another one on the middle pole line, it is a googly and again Tahir misses.
Wide! Way outside off, Hussain leaves it alone.
Beauty! Googly on the off pole line, Hussain does not pick it up at all. Hussain looks to defend off the back foot but does so inside the line and misses the ball completely. Bishnoi is on fire here!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated outside off, pushed towards the off side.

NOT OUT! Jurel is smart but not smart enough! A flatter googly outside off, it's fired by Bishnoi at 86 kph, Hussain rocks back to slap it through the line but misses. The keeper collects the ball, waits and then takes the bails off. He appeals, looking for a stumping, and the square leg umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in and they find that Tahir had never lifted his back foot, only dragged it, that too inside the crease. Good awareness from Jurel though to try something like this.
Stumping appeal! This does not look too serious though.
Tahir Hussain is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Ravi Bishnoi comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway! Googly just outside off, Afridi looks to play at this one but the ball turns in and he misses. The ball hits Afridi on the pads and the Indians put in a loud appeal. The umpire raises his finger and sends Afridi packing. It looks to be going down leg to the naked eye but no reviews here and Afridi has to continue walking back.
Ravi Bishnoi, the leggie is back into the attack. 8-0-44-1 are his figures so far.

FOUR! Misfield by Jaiswal this time in the deep and it looks like he can do something wrong. Back of a length delivery outside off, Nazir cuts this one towards backward point. Jaiswal there tumbles to stop the ball but lets it through and a boundary results.
Again on off, this time Abbas Afridi plays it towards cover for a single.
Full ball on off, Nazir has driven this one superbly towards sweeper cover but just for a single.
Another full toss on the pads, Abbas Afridi plays this one towards the leg side and takes a single to get off the mark.
Abbas Afridi walks in.

OUT! TIMBER! Jaffa from Tyagi! Corker of a yorker and that has sent the off pole cart-wheeling. Tyagi steams in and bowls an inswinging yorker. Irfan Khan tries to bring his bat down in time but is late in doing so. Khan misses and Tyagi hits. Another one goes down for Pakistan and India into the tailenders now.
Kartik Tyagi starts his new spell with a full toss on the pads, Irfan Khan misses out on it as he plays this one towards the man at mid on.
Kartik Tyagi is back on. 5-0-20-0 so far.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary for Pakistan. Short and outside off, Nazir rocks back and cuts it precisely between short third man and backward point for a boundary!
WIDE. Down the leg side, Nazir looks to sweep but misses.
Works this through mid on, beating the dive from short mid-wicket and gets a single.
Finally gets to his half century. Full and outside off, Nazir comes down the track and drives it through the covers for a single. Can he bat through till the end?
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
A low full toss, on leg stump, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Huge shout for LBW, turned down. Clearly pitching outside leg and the umpire asks the bowler to calm down. Nazir looked to flick but missed and was hit on the pads.
A short ball, outside off, pulled away but straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
A short ball, outside off, punched straight to point.

Good stop but cannot stop the single. Full and outside off, Irfan drives this through the covers where Yashasvi Jaiswal dives to his left and makes a partial stop. That enables the batsmen to cross over.
A short ball, around off, Irfan looks to pull but the ball does not quite come off the deck. He is forced to check his shot and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
A length ball, outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Outside off, pushed through the batsman drives it towards point. Just 2 runs and a wicket from the over, Ankolekar's figures read 6-0-21-1.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Into the bowlers now. Or bowlers who can bat. Irfan Khan comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is a blinder from Divyaansh Saxena and this has sent Mohammad Haris, the aggressor of the Pakistan innings, back in the hut. A floated delivery on middle and off, Haris goes down on one knee and plays a sweep shot uppishly. The ball is going towards backward square leg and away from Saxena. Divyaansh runs to his right from square leg and puts in a full length dive to take the catch inches above the ground. The Indian players are pumped! The umpires want to check if the catch has been taken cleanly so they refer it upstairs with the soft signal being out. Replays roll in to show that Saxena has done his job superbly. Pakistan in real trouble now and wickets are falling at regular intervals.

That is a stunning catch! Or is it? The Indians are claiming it but the batsman is not going anywhere. The umpires refer it upstairs with the soft signal as OUT. Here comes the replay. Looks as clean as a whistle. Yes. Bye bye, Haris.
Floated on middle and leg, driven down towards long on for a single.
Nazir comes down the track and defends this full ball out.
Floated on off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Atharva Ankolekar is back on. 5-0-19-0 so far.

Woah! That just came out of nowhere! A full toss on off, this looks clearly above waist height but the umpire rules it as a legal delivery. Nazir somehow guides this one down towards the man at point and is asking the question but nothing from the leg umpire.
Good length delivery just outside off, helped down to third man for a single.
Length ball on middle, angling in, Nazir looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat towards cover and the batters take a single.
On off, this time guided down to third man for a single properly.

A length ball on the off pole line, Nazir looks to guide this one down towards third man but gets an inside edge on it. Singh appeals but in vain as the batters take a single as the ball rolls towards point.
A very full ball on the off pole line, angling in. Haris jams it out towards mid on and the batters take a quick single.

DRINKS BREAK. India seem to be on top but the situation is 50-50 to be honest. The track looks to be a good one to bat on but every now and then  the odd ball bounces. There is turn on offer as well. To sum it up, Pakistan need to ensure that they bat their full quota of 50 overs and get as close as possible to the 225-mark.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, driven towards the man at mid on.
Flatter one outside off again, Nazir plays this one towards sweeper cover for a couple.
On the pads, worked away towards the leg side for a single.
SIX! Great shot by Haris and it looks like he is trying to up the run-rate here. Floated on middle, Haris goes down on one knee and slogs this one over mid-wicket for a maximum.
This time flat and full outside off by Bishnoi, Rohail prods forward and plays this one towards cover for a single.
Flatter delivery down the leg side, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, defended towards the off side.
Back of a length ball on middle, Haris rocks back and helps this one towards square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed towards the man at mid off.

Excellent running. A length ball, around off, MH just taps it towards fine leg, with soft hands and sees that deep mid-wicket has to run after it. Observes that fine leg is pretty square and calls for two. Makes it.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Immediately he comes around the wicket, bowls it on the pads, Haris flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Akash Singh returns. 4-0-13-0 so far.
Full and outside off, plenty of flight, driven to sweeper cover for a single. Another productive over for India.
FOUR! Slashed hard! Short and outside off, Haris looks to cut but there is extra bounce on that one. The ball takes the outside edge and flies just wide of first slip, to the third man fence.
Floated delivery on middle and off, Haris defends this one off the front foot onto the ground.
Mohammad Haris walks in now. Still 117 balls left in this innings.

OUT! RUN OUT! Woah, talk about shooting yourselves in the foot and that is what Pakistan have done here. Flatter delivery just outside off, Akram guides this one towards point with soft hands and takes off for a single. His partner responds but then sees there is no run available and turns back. It is a race between Akram and Nazir as to who will reach in time at the non-striker's end. Nazir wins that race and Ankolekar throws the ball towards the striker's end where Jurel whips off the bails. Qasim Akram has to walk back but Bishnoi is almost disappointed that his team did not get the wicket of the Pakistani skipper there. However, another step forward for India.
Flatter one on middle and off, defended by Akram again.
Floated on middle and off, defended by Qasim Akram.
Ravi Bishnoi is back on. 6-0-28-1 so far.
Flatter delivery outside off, Akram rocks back and plays this one towards the man at deep point for a single.
Floated on off, pushed towards the man at cover.

FOUR! Jaiswal does not look happy as Tyagi could have stopped that one from crossing the ropes. Floated delivery on middle and leg, Akram goes down on one knee and sweeps this one towards mid-wicket. Tyagi runs to his right in the deep but overruns and lets the ball sneak underneath his body for a boundary.
Another one on off, played towards the man at point again.
Flatter one on off, played towards point.
Nazir comes down the track and plays this one on the full down to long on for a single.

Superb fielding in the deep! Down the leg side, Akram does well to flick this one behind square on the leg side. The fielder from fine leg runs to his left and dives to make a brilliant stop. Two runs taken.
Length ball just outside off, Nazir plays this one towards point. The fielder there runs to his left and makes a half stop and the batters take a run.
FOUR! What a shot by Nazir! Full ball wide outside off, Nazir goes hard at this one and the ball flashes past the man at point and into the fence.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Rohail Nazir ducks under it. This looked like to be going over Nazir's head but the umpire has given it as a legal delivery.
Length ball on middle and leg, Akram swivels and pulls this one behind square leg for a single.
Bouncer outside off, Qasim Akram looks to have a slash at it but misses the ball.
Outside off, short in length, punched straight to cover.

Ahahahaha..... beautifully bowled, Yashasvi Warney. Floated with plenty of loop, around leg, Nazir looks to play the sweep but the ball dips on him and he simply does not get any length. Finds a yorker length and he has to adjust late to dab it to point.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
FOUR! This time Nazir does not miss out. Short and outside off, Rohail goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary!

Comes down the track, does the skipper and hits this hard but his partner comes in the way. Qasim tries to get out of the way but cannot do so in time. The ball hits his pad and deflects towards mid on. Saves a boundary.
Tossed up around middle, pushed back to the bowler.

Length ball outside off again, this time played just in front of point and Nazir will keep strike for the next over as he completes a single. This also brings up the 100 for Pakistan. They are going slow right now and need to up the run-flow soon.
Length ball just outside off, Akram punches this one towards backward point and the batters take a single. Akram gets off the mark with this one.
Good length ball just outside off, Akram looks to push at it but the ball goes off the inside edge onto the pads and then towards cover.
Outside off, played towards point for a single.

A louder appeal this time but again turned down! Bouncer outside off, Nazir looks to cut at this one but fails to do so. Dhruv Jurel collects the ball and appeals along with the bowler but the umpire turns it down.
Wide! Down the leg side, Nazir looks to flick but fails to do so. The Indians appeal but the umpire signals it as a wide.
Good delivery to start off the new spell by Mishra. Length ball just outside off, angling away from Nazir. He looks to have a poke at it but misses.
Sushant Mishra returns. 5-0-14-1 so far.
Flatter one just outside off, Akram guides this one down to the short third man fielder. A successful over for India comes to an end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Qasim Akram prods forward and does well to defend it out.
Qasim Akram walks in at number 5, replacing Haider.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ravi Bishnoi takes the catch and it looks like Yashasvi Jaiswal can't do anything wrong at the moment. A part-timer strikes for India! He bowls a flatter one outside off, it is there to be hit. Haider Ali plays the cut shot but straight to the man at point, Ravi Bishnoi. A crucial breakthrough as the threatening stand is broken.
Flatter one on off, pushed towards the point region for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off by Jaiswal, Nazir drives this one towards cover but Garg there makes a superb stop.
Interesting. Yashasvi Jaiswal has been given the ball. Bit of a punt by Priyam Garg. A leggie always gives you wickets. Anyone remember Marnus Labuschagne?
Floated on off, pushed towards cover for a single. 95/2 Pakistan at the halfway mark.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Floated on off, pushed towards cover.
Floated delivery on middle and off, pushed towards the man at long off for one.
Floated delivery on middle and off, Ali prods forward and defends.
This time it is the googly again. Nazir expects the normal leg spinner but is deceived as he looks to cut. He is hit down the leg side on the pads and the stifled appeal dies down.

Googly by Bishnoi and it almost bore fruit! It is a touch short and just outside off, Nazir looks to cut but gets an inside edge and almost chops it on but the ball goes off the pads then towards third man.
Good running by the Pakistan batters! On the pads by Bishnoi, worked towards the man at short fine leg and the batters take a quick single.
Beaten! Flighted and outside off, going straight on, Ali plays for the spin and is beaten.
Tossed up ball around off, Ali gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point.

EDGY FOUR! Haider Ali brings up his fifty. Flighted leg spinner outside off, on the fuller length, Ali tries to drive through covers but it takes the outside half of his bat and runs away from backward point for a boundary. Fine knock by Ali, he had his issues at the start, in particularly against Mishra, but he weathered the storm and is now looking set for a big one here.

Appeal turned down! Beauty by Ankolekar! A very loopy delivery around off, it is angling in and then it straightens. Nazir looks to defend but does so inside the line. The Indians appeal as they think that there is a faint edge on that but the umpire denies it.
Flatter delivery just outside off, Nazir rocks back and defends.
Another one on middle and leg, tossed up, played down towards long on for a single.
On middle and leg, tossed up, worked towards the man at mid-wicket.
Floated on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Flatter delivery on off, played towards point.
Ali comes forward and defends it out.

FOUR! Swept away! Floated delivery on middle and leg, Ali goes down on one knee and sweeps this one fine down the leg side for a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up between Ali and Nazir off 80 balls. They have to up the ante from here.
On the pads, played towards the man at mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, Ali pushes this one towards the off side but straight to the man.
Another one on off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Floated on middle and off, it is a googly, Ali defends this one towards the bowler.
On off, driven towards the man at mid on.
Outside off, Ali has pushed this one towards cover and the batters take a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, pushed down towards long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Tossed up delivery on off, the ball pitches and straightens. Nazir looks to push at it but the ball goes off the outer half towards point. The fielder there collects the ball and gives it to Jurel at the striker's end who dislodges the bails. However, the batters complete the single easily.
Loopy delivery on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, worked towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Ali prods forward and defends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Wonderfully done! Floated delivery outside off, Ali uses the pace of the ball and guides this one down towards third man. He beats the man at short third man and the ball races away to the fence.
Again on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, worked towards mid-wicket and the batters take a single.
Ravi Bishnoi is back on. 3-0-13-1 so far.
FOUR! Good shot by Ali! Floated on middle and off, Ankolekar sweeps this one behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on middle and off, Haider looks to play at it but the ball spins away and Haider Ali plays inside the line of the delivery.
Another one driven towards mid off and the batters take a single.
Tossed up on off, driven down to long off for a single past the diving mid off fielder.
Given a lot of air on this one, Nazir pushes this towards the left of sweeper cover and the batters change ends.
Floated on the off pole line, pushed towards the man at cover.
Full ball on the off pole line, Nazir plays this one towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single to retain strike for the next over.
A bouncer outside off, Rohail rocks back and pulls this ball towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball on middle and leg, Haider looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat towards point and the batters take a single.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Haider ducks under it.
A really good line by Akash Singh! Length ball just around the off pole line, Haider Ali looks to have a poke at it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Full ball on off, angling in, pushed back straight towards the left of Akash who stops it with his left hand.
Short and outside off, Nazir cuts this through point for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Tossed up outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full again, driven back to the bowler once more.
Very full and around off, driven straight to mid off.
A ripper first up! Full and around off, Haider looks to defend but the ball spins, bounces and rips past the outside edge. The keeper appeals for the catch but the umpire shakes his head.
Here comes the unsung hero. Atharva Ankolekar to bowl.
On the pads of Haider, he flicks this one towards square leg for a single.
Finally Nazir changes ends as he pushes this good length ball on the off side towards covers for one.

DROPPED! Akash Singh's persistence almost paid off and Rohail Nazir lost his patience. This time a back of a length ball on the body, Nazir rocks back and looks to pull. Nazir gets a top edge and the ball lobs towards mid on. Sushant Mishra runs in from the edge of the circle, dives forward but cannot gather the ball. A very good effort but still no reward. Life for the Pakistani skipper and he will now be looking to make the most of it.
Akash Singh consistently testing Rohail Nazir but the Pakistan skipper again plays this length ball towards the man at point.
Similar delivery, again Nazir rocks back and plays this straight to the man at point.
Length ball just around the off pole line, angling in, Nazir plays this towards point off the back foot.

DRINKS. A look at the scoreboard might just tell you nothing is happening. Wrong impression. India have put Pakistan in all sorts of trouble but have just the 2 wickets to show for their efforts. Every bowler who has come has given it his all and the Pakistan batsmen are just trying to survive. Haider Ali is hanging in there, after racing through the Powerplay while captain Rohail Nazir is looking solid.
On off by Tyagi, Nazir comes forward and pushes this one towards cover for a single. 4 runs off the over.
Good length ball just outside off, Nazir plays this one towards the man at point.
A yorker now, on the middle and off pole line, Rohail Nazir just about digs the ball out and the ball stays right near his boot.
Length ball again, width on offer, Rohail rocks back and plays this one towards deep point for a couple.
Good length ball on the off side, Haider prods forward and pushes this one towards cover-point for a single.
Swing and a miss! A length ball outside off, Ali goes chasing after it and looks to cut but misses the ball.
Full and wide outside off, let through.
On a good length, outside off, watchfully defended.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! BLUDGEONED! Short and wide outside off, Nazir slaps it through point and gets a boundary! 50 UP FOR PAKISTAN. They started off well but then have slowed down considerably.
A length ball, outside off, angling away, left alone.
Full and wide outside off, RN looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes to third man. A single taken.
Oohhh... frustration. Hint of width outside off, fuller in length, Rohail's eyes lit up, goes for the full-blooded drive but is beaten.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
On a length, but bowling from wide of the crease and landing it wide outside off. Left alone.
Another jaffa. A length ball outside off, Nazir plays inside the line, looking to defend but is beaten as the ball keeps coming in.
A length ball outside off, tapped towards point for a quick single.
Kartik Tyagi (3-0-14-0) is back into the attack.
On a length and around off, Nazir stays back and cuts it towards point. 3 from Akash's first over!

An overpitched delivery outside off, Nazir tries to drive but gets a thick outside edge down to third man. Siddhesh Veer runs across to his left and does well to half-stop the racing ball. He fumbles slightly while picking it up and that allows the batsmen to take the second run.
Pitches it up and around off, Nazir doesn't entirely get forward as he drives it to point. Singh has a word with the Pakistani skipper and the umpire quickly gets involved.
Once again Akash takes a good length delivery away from the batsman with his angle. Rohail watches it go through to the keeper.
Angling away from the batsman, on a driving length outside off, Nazir covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Shortish and around off, Ali cuts it off his back foot through cover-point for a single.
Sushant Mishra gets a breather after bowling five impressive overs. It's going to be Akash Singh to bowl from this end now.
Too full in length around off, it's knocked down to long on for one.
Edgy! Bishnoi serves a googly around off, fuller in length, Rohail lunges to defend but it takes the inside edge. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen switch ends.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to cover-point.
FOUR! Shot! This time Bishnoi is very full with his length and delivers it outside off, Nazir leans into the drive and thumps it with the spin to the sweeper cover fence.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended back off the front foot.
Flighted and full ball on middle, Rohail presses forward and defends it back.
Powerplay 2 is underway! A maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of the 40th over.
Slants in a fuller length ball on middle, it's clipped across the line but straight to mid-wicket. A good Powerplay 1 for India!

Idea was right but not the execution! Mishra dishes out a back of a length ball around off and gets it to straighten off the seam. Haider attempts to loft it over the bowler's head with a straight bat but fails to connect.
Wide! Mishra loses his line this time. From 'round the wicket angle, he bowls a bouncer but it goes down with the angle. Ali ducks and the umpire turns to signal a wide.
Mishra switches to 'round the wicket and bangs in a bouncer around off, Haider once again lets it go.
Pitches it up and around off, Ali pushes it off his front foot to covers.
A length ball around off, angling away, Ali drives it through the line but finds the cover-point fielder.
Bouncer around middle and leg, Ali decides to duck underneath it.
Beaten! Nazir fails to pick the googly. He stays back to push it through the line, maybe thinking it will spin away, but the ball curls back in to beat the inside edge. Excellent over by the leggie!
Wide! A googly goes wrong. Bishnoi slips it down the leg side, Nazir tries to flick but misses.
Skipper Rohail Nazir arrives in the middle at number 4.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Munir has completely miscued his shot. A flatter and shorter googly around middle and off, Fahad rocks back to attempt for a pull shot but doesn't account for the away spin. He gets a top edge and it's an easy catch for Ankolekar at cover-point. Bishnoi strikes and continues to impress in this tournament. Munir departs for a duck after facing 16 balls.
Slow loopy ball around off, turning away from the left-hander, Munir eases it off his front foot to the cover fielder.
Fullish and around off, Ali helps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and very full around off, it's driven off the front foot but once again straight to the fielder at covers.
Nicely floated full ball on off, Haider drives with the turn but finds the cover fielder.
A high full toss around off, Fahad rises a bit high and plays it down towards point. The square leg umpire feels that it's below waist and that will be the end of the over.
Slightly short in length around off, angling in, Fahad is hurried up into his pull shot and plays it towards square leg. No timing or placement.
A yorker outside off, Munir digs it out towards the cover fielder.
Well played and well run as well! Ali uses the angle of the left-arm bowler and taps it in front of backward point. They cross for a quick single.
Mishra bends his back this time and bowls a bouncer around off, Haider ducks safely.
Full in length and close to off, Ali gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length on off, Ali drives it through mid off and retains strike with a single.
Quicker through the air, a googly once again, Ali allows it through to the keeper.
FOUR! A good positive shot by Ali on this occasion. Flighted ball landing full around off, Ali goes down and slogs it over mid on. It falls safely in the deep before crossing the fence.
A gentle leg spinner. Flighted and around off, Ali defends it off his front foot.
Inside edge saves Haider! Another googly by Bishnoi. Ali prods forward to defend but it takes the inner half and strikes him on the pads. The appeal for an lbw dies down quickly.
Starts with a googly on the fuller side outside off, Haider gets forward and defends it on the leg side.
Time for some leg spin magic! Here comes Ravi Bishnoi. India are attacking with a slip.
Good length ball on off, it's punched from the back foot to covers. Tidy over by Sushant!
Straight to point! Short in length and outside off, Fahad slaps it from the crease but finds the point fielder. Times his shot well but fails to pierce the gap.
Back of a length ball around off, angling in, Munir stays back and pushes it to the cover fielder.
Fuller length ball around off, shaping in, Fahad defends it solidly to the leg side. Resolute.
This time Mishra eyes an inswinging yorker but fails to land it. Munir receives it on the full and keeps it out on the off side.
Slower bouncer around off, Munir allows it through to the keeper once again.
That's a wide! Mishra bowls it with a slightly slinging action and delivers it outside the tramline on off. Munir allows it through to the keeper.
FOUR! That is a fine shot! Overpitched outside off, Haider drives it beautifully down the ground and beats mid off!
A full toss, outside off, punched straight to mid off.
FOUR! BLAST! Short and wide outside off, Ali crashes it through point and gets a boundary!
WIDE. A bouncer down the leg side, left alone.
Well wide outside off, left alone.
That is a ripper of a delivery. On a length outside off, Ali looks to defend but the ball seams in and beats the outside edge.
Another inswinging delivery. This is around off, Haider just about gets his bat down to defend.
Good length delivery outside off, holding its line, Munir pushes inside the line and misses. Top over by Mishra!
Munir has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Periscope! Mishra is having Haider Ali in all sorts of trouble. Another well-directed bumper. He clocks 139 kph and Haider once again shows poor technique. Takes his eyes off the ball and keeps his bat hanging like a periscope. It catches his blade and flies down to third man. Luckily it has not gone straight to the fielder. A single is taken and Ali would take this opportunity to catch his breath.
Physio makes his appearance! Magic spray will come out soon to ease his pain.

Ouch! That's struck Haider flush on the left shoulder. He's in deep pain and the physio has been summoned immediately. Mishra once again surprises the batsman with a bouncer. A well-directed one. Haider picks it late, maybe. Tries to duck by taking his eyes off the ball. He is struck on the left shoulder and it balloons towards gully. The Indian players get excited but no one catches it. Now, they walk up to Haider to check his well-being. He is rubbing his shoulder in pain.
FOUR! You don't need to run for those. A cracking shot by Ali. Mishra overpitches a shade and delivers it close to off, Haider takes his front leg forward and drives it crisply through cover-point.
Wide! Mishra keeps on surprising the batsman with a bouncer. Delivers one again but it's down the leg side and has been given as a wide.
A length delivery in the channel outside off, angling away from the right-hander, Haider watches the line closely before making a leave.
A yorker to end the over. Outside off, Fahad looks to dig it out but misses.

Another huge shout for LBW. Turned down again. Did this pitch outside leg? Perhaps. Very full, around leg, Munir looks to flick across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. As per Rohan Gavaskar on air, even if it did pitch outside leg, did not pitch too far!
Outside off, tapped through point for a single.
Outside off again, wider than the previous one, let through once more.
Well wide outside off, left alone.

Drama all around! What a ball. Full and around off, almost a yorker, Munir looks to get his bat down but misses. The ball swings in, the bat hits his boot and Tyagi appeals for LBW. The umpire shakes his head but the fun does not end there. The keeper Jurel decides to catch the batsman off guard and under-arms a shy at the striker's end, aiming to stump the batsman. He misses and the bowler is not aware that the throw is coming to him. Mid on chases after it and the batsmen take a bye.
Fahad Munir walks in at number 3, replacing Huraira.

OUT! The star of the show against Afghanistan is gone cheaply! The Indian boys are ecstatic. Early breakthrough for them. Mishra keeps on altering his length in this over. This time he pitches it back of a length around middle, Huraira turns to pull but it collects the top edge and flies in front of square leg. Divyaansh Saxena settles underneath it and takes the skier safely.

Shout for a caught behind, not given! It's in fact given as a WIDE! Mishra follows up the fuller length ball with a bouncer just outside leg. Huraira tries to pull but fails to connect. It flies over his gloves and Jurel appeals after collecting the ball. The umpire though turns to signal a wide.
Very full and on middle, moving back into the batsman, Huraira keeps it out safely on the leg side.
Around off on a length, angling away, Huraira is forward in defense.
Mishra delivers it around middle and off, Huraira is on the front foot in defense but it takes the bottom half of his bat and rolls just wide of the stumps.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Shot! Huraira is off the mark in style. The line from Mishra is very straight and Huraira makes full use of it. Flicks it across the line, finds the gap at mid-wicket and sends it across the boundary line.
Sushant Mishra to operate from the other end. He steams in but Huraira pulls out at the last moment. Maybe, he wasn't ready.
On a length and outside off, Haider makes a leave. Excellent first over by Tyagi!
A length delivery outside off, Ali drives it off his front foot to covers.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Haider allows it through.

EDGY FOUR! Pakistan are off the mark in the most nervy way possible. Tyagi bowls a couple of deliveries in the region outside off and then out of nowhere dishes out a terrific yorker. It tails in the air as it approaches the stumps and Ali luckily gets his bat in time to dig it out. However, it kisses the inside edge, beats the stumps and hurries away to the fine leg fence.
Flirting with the wide line! Tyagi delivers it on a back of a length and outside off, Haider shoulders arms. Lucky to get away with that!
Tyagi begins with a tempter! He serves it full and wide outside off, there to be driven but Ali restrains himself from going after it.

All in readiness in Potch! The Indian team is in a huddle. Haider Ali and Mohammad Huraira walk out to the centre to open for Pakistan. The latter had a great debut game against Afghanistan and would like to repeat it against arch-rivals. Kartik Tyagi to kickoff proceedings for the Blue team. Two slips waiting. Here we go...
The boys from both teams are out in the middle as it's time for the national anthems. Pakistan's first, followed by India's...
Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Haider Ali, Mohammad Huraira, Rohail Nazir (C/WK), Fahad Munir, Qasim Akram, Mohammad Haris, Irfan Khan, Abbas Afridi, Tahir Hussain, Amir Ali, Mohammad Amir Khan.

India (Unchanged Playing XI) - Yashasvi Jaiswal, Divyaansh Saxena, Tilak Varma, Priyam Garg (C), Dhruv Jurel (WK), Siddhesh Veer, Atharva Ankolekar, Ravi Bishnoi, Sushant Mishra, Kartik Tyagi, Akash Singh.

Indian captain, Priyam Garg, says that he is happy bowling first. On the hype surrounding Ind-Pak matches, Priyam says that the crowd makes it more hyped than the players and the latter simply look to play it as a normal game. On being asked which is India's stronger aspect, Garg touts bowling as India's strong factor. Informs that India too, are going unchanged from the previous game.

Pakistan's skipper, Rohail Nazir, says that he is batting because it's a semi-final and they want to put runs on the board and defend it. Adds that this is the time to make a mark in a big game against India. On the rivalry, he replies that it's always a bigger one and they are looking forward to the challenge. Nazir wants to play good cricket and informs that they are unchanged.
Toss - Up goes the coin, Rohail Nazir calls it correctly and PAKISTAN ELECT TO BAT!

If we recap the performances of these two units, both come across as a team well-equipped to last the distance. The bowling attacks of India and Pakistan are loaded with talent and since the pitches are getting tired, the spinners are expected to play a major role. On the batting front, the Indians will be in a good space after surviving the challenge of Australia and that would have given them handy confidence. For Pakistan, they too were in a tricky position against Afghanistan but since the target wasn't too much, they survived a scare and sailed through eventually. How will they counter the Indian spinners?

It's here! The most-awaited match of the ICC Under19 World Cup 2020 is about to get underway. India vs Pakistan. At Senwes Park, Potchefstroom. Doesn't matter which sport, doesn't matter which place, when these two rivals collide, the world stops and watches with keen interest. The stage is set for the young guns to show what they are capable of and how the future of cricket looks like, especially in the subcontinent. Without a doubt, there will be tension in both the camps, high expectations of the fans across the border of these two nations and whoever deals with it better will come out trumps and win the ticket to the finale. On that note, allow us to welcome you for the coverage of this electric contest. Stay tuned for more...
